name: What return on investment (ROI) can I expect from a home remodel?

mainEntity.name: What return on investment (ROI) can I expect from a home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The return on investment (ROI) for a home remodel varies significantly depending on the project type, location, and market conditions. Mid-range kitchen and bathroom remodels, as well as minor exterior upgrades like a garage door replacement, often yield the highest ROI, typically recouping 60-80% of their cost at resale. Luxury or highly personalized renovations may see a lower percentage return. Consult with a local real estate professional to understand specific market trends in areas like Huntington Beach or Irvine.
